full_judgment: "Mr. Mahbubey Alam, the learned Counsel for the petitioners submits that it is not a case of contradiction of evidence on the point of knowledge of the preemptor-petitioner regarding transfer of the case land and the learned Judge of the High Court Division erred in reversing the judgment   and order of the trial Court as well as the appellate Court below without due and proper advertence to the material evidence on record and also on erratic evaluation of the evidence of the pre-emptor-petitioner as regards his knowledge of transfer of the case land. In other words, it is submitted by Mr. Mahbubey Alam, the impugned judgment of the High Court Division is not a proper judgment of reversal as it is not supported by any valid reasoning as well as proper discussion of the material evidence,"
